title: m2w-chat (chat_format.json)
description: The string pieces of the model's chat template, cut out by rendering it with sentinel messages (the runtime never runs jinja). Turn 1 = first_prefix [or first_prefix_with_system with <<system>> replaced] + user text + user_suffix_generation_prompt; later turns = previous answer + assistant_suffix + next_user_prefix + user text + user_suffix_generation_prompt. A finished turn is rendered with user_suffix_assistant_prefix instead of the generation prompt. <<date:fmt>> is replaced by strftime(fmt) of the current time.
